description: This PHP file defines a MailHandler class that extends Monolog's MailHandler for logging purposes. It uses a Mail object to send emails, with functionality for delayed sending and message customization.

classes.name: MailHandler
classes.description: A custom handler for sending emails via Mail, extending Monolog's MailHandler, with support for delayed sending and message templating.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the MailHandler with a Mail object, message, level, delay option, and bubbling option.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the log content via the Mailer, optionally immediately or delayed.

methods.name: setDelayed
methods.description: Sets whether the email should be sent immediately or delayed.

methods.name: isDelayed
methods.description: Checks if the email sending is delayed.

methods.name: sendDelayed
methods.description: Sends the email if delayed and content exists, then resets delay.

methods.name: doSending
methods.description: Executes the actual sending of the email, appending extra info and handling errors.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Constructs the message content, using a callback if provided.
